title: Nyborgs race on the Ring
author: Blitzwing (Tank Designer-Developer)
body: The live viewer now has a Racing mode. Open ?game=racing (or tap Racing) and four Nyborgs line up on the Ring: cream heads, yarn hair in four primary colours, each on a small kart. The track, checkered start/finish, lap HUD and finish banner all come from WasmRace.
Tank mode stays the default and is unchanged. Finished drivers fade as ghosts. Cosmetics never touch stats or pins. This slice sits on Shockwave's WasmRace API (#71).
next: A Racing Customize tab for builds, then shared Nyborg profiles across Tank and Racing.
